beats.care: If you live in Kukatpally, Miyapur, Ameerpet or Secunderabad, store water, fix leaks, and expect pricier tankers next summer.
beats.what: The water board, HMWSSB, plans to cut supply from the Manjeera source by 10 million gallons a day from December.
beats.why: Singur and Manjeera reservoirs are well below full, and officials expect levels to fall sharply within a month, before summer demand peaks.

cards.body: Today Singur gives 71 MGD against a scheduled 75, and Manjeera 44 against 45. Two pumps at emergency stations have run since late September, and more will start as levels fall.
KPHB, Pragathi Nagar, Miyapur, Chanda Nagar, SR Nagar, Ameerpet, Sanath Nagar, parts of Begumpet, Patancheru, Lingampally, Secunderabad Cantonment, Bowenpally and Alwal, Telangana Today reports.
cards.title: which areas get manjeera water?

cards.body: Of the metro area's 14.5 lakh water connections, about 3 lakh in Singur and Manjeera areas could face shortages, officials assess.
cards.caption: Connections at risk by December

cards.body: The Krishna basin's reservoirs hold just 78.5 of 270 TMC, a 71% shortfall, so the city can't easily lean on other rivers.

cards.q: Best fix for the water crunch?
Why is the water board planning a cut now?
cards.why: Cutting a little early stretches stored water so it lasts through peak summer demand.
